items.title: 25.1 Synthesis and Retrosynthesis (banana aur ulta peeche ki taraf sochna) (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Koi organic compound banana shuru karne se pehle chemical reactions, reagents (react karane wali cheezen) aur har step complete karne ke liye zaroori conditions (halaat) samajhna zaroori hai, taa ke target molecule yaqeeni tor par ban jaye.

Zyada tar organic compounds kai alag routes (raaston) se ban sakte hain, aur best route chunne ke liye kuch criteria (pakhne ke usool) chahiye. Kisi cheez ki achhi synthesis woh hai jo saste aur aasani se milne wale starting materials (shuru ki cheezen) ko aise route se desired (matloob) product mein badle jis mein kam se kam steps hon aur overall yield (aakhir mein milne wale product ki miqdar) zyada ho.

Organic synthesis mein kaam aane wale bohat se organic reactions maloom hain. Inhein do types mein divide kiya ja sakta hai: ya to yeh functional group interconversion (FGI, yani aik functional group ko doosre mein badalna) karte hain, ya carbon-carbon bond banate hain. Carbon-carbon bond banane wale reactions khaas tor par important hain, kyun ke synthesis ki basic strategy (plan) yeh hai ke target molecule ko simple aur chhote starting materials ko jor kar banaya jaye.

blocks.prompt: Achhi synthesis ka raasta kaisa hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Starting materials saste aur aasani se milne wale hon, steps kam se kam hon aur overall yield zyada ho.

items: Har step ka reaction, reagent aur conditions pehle samjhein.
Best route: saste starting materials, kam steps, zyada overall yield.
Synthesis ke reactions do types ke: FGI ya carbon-carbon bond banana.
